ORCHESTRATOR RULING on lint_verification WARN ('VERIFIED but its evidence hedges -- should this be PARTIAL?'). Keeping VERIFIED. The stated bar is that the route distinguishes every item from every other item, and it does: all 48 cells of the 6x8 score-count matrix reproduce the live table exactly and 0 of 15 problem pairs share a distribution. The hedge is that the route ties each code to an official SCORE COLUMN, while the column-to-WORDING tie rests on the official archive numbering its problems 1-6 in the same order -- a documentary fact no statistical route could test, and one that is identical for imos_1987 (which lint did not flag, so the two rows differ only in phrasing, not in strength). Downgrading this to PARTIAL would make PARTIAL the ceiling for every paper_explicit table whose codes are source column names, which would drain the distinction of meaning. The hedge is retained in the evidence deliberately: it states what the route does not establish, exactly as required.
